title: kissed lime tunisian dish bake
description:
a low-carb-friendly, date-night tunisian dish featuring lime, baked in a wok with a hint of romance
perfect for a quiet evening with your loved one
instructions: in a wok, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat
add the chicken breast fillets and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes
add the zucchini, yellow squash, and red bell pepper to the wok and cook for an additional 3 minutes
stir in the green olives, artichoke hearts, lime juice, cumin, and almond flour
transfer the wok to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes
remove from the oven and top with feta cheese
serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley
enjoy your kissed lime tunisian dish bake!
let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving
serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a green salad for a complete meal
